meta.title: Change ledger (MemLedger)
meta.description: Equips every session with a spatial repo map and a temporal change ledger. Eight agent tools — ledger_map, ledger_check, ledger_add, ledger_search, ledger_verify, ledger_requirement, ledger_suite, and ledger_bootstrap — let the agent locate code without scanning, detect rollback risks and duplicate fixes before editing, and persist decision rationale after changes. The "Ledger & Map" tab in the session view shows an effectiveness dashboard, a skeleton + ledger browser, and a contract-score panel. Rules are auto-injected into ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md on activation; no manual configuration is needed.
